notes.title: D8 Dice and More
notes.notes:
Hello there,
Long time to see. 
We are making more progress on the game.
Lately we were working on other commission works and prototypes.

We will continue  to Dice vs Dice at full speed.

This week we present D8 dice that you can get from Tinkerer on the map.

More dice are coming.

And also there is a lot of fixes :D

Murat Karakaş
CodingApe Games

notes.title: Balancing and Changes
notes.notes:
Helloo there,

Everybody said, game is a little easy. So we turn some knobs and balance the damages.
And also you need to defeat every minion before fight with boss.

notes.title: Gambler
notes.notes:
Heey,
You can spend your Boss Keys at Gambler. But you need to roll.
But don't forget if you roll double one, you get nothing.

CodingApe Games

notes.title: Blacksmiths
notes.notes:
Hey hey hey, time to go to blacksmith. They will give you item for your journey.

And it is free :D

CodingApe Games

notes.title: Villagers
notes.notes:
Hey,

Now there are some villagers on maps. You can talk with them and learn about lore of the game and how their lives are hard.

notes.title: Rougelite Feature - Boss Keys
notes.notes:
Hey Friends,

We finally implement our first Rougelite feature to the game.
Now you can collect keys from bosses.
With these keys, you can level up the heroes for your next runs.

There are currently 5 levels for each heroes.
More is coming;
New items,
New buildings,
World events, quests,
And of course new chapter to the story.

So Long, and Thanks for All the Fish

Murat Karakaş
Coding Ape Games
